system.name: AegisGrid Resilience Model
system.disclaimer: All infrastructure actions, impacts, and recovery workflows are simulated. Never claim simulated actions repaired real physical infrastructure.

S-01.name: Electrical Substation
S-01.description: Primary high-voltage distribution substation feeding water pumping, traffic signaling, and hospital main line.

W-02.name: Water Pump Station
W-02.description: Potable and cooling water distribution pump station requiring primary electricity from S-01.

T-04.name: Traffic Signals & Emergency Corridor
T-04.description: Synchronized intersection signals along the primary emergency vehicle corridor connecting district sectors.

H-01.name: Hospital Critical Care & Backup Feeder
H-01.description: Regional trauma hospital requiring continuous electricity (primary S-01, reserve G-01) and water pressure.

G-01.name: Backup Generator Station
G-01.description: Dedicated diesel/gas emergency turbine generator providing redundant power to hospital and substation bus during outages.

RA-01.action: Isolate upstream feeder and reroute demand to reserve bus
RA-01.rationale: Mitigates cascading electrical fault propagation while stabilizing feeder bus.

RA-02.action: Shift pump staging to emergency reserve pressure setpoint
RA-02.rationale: Maintains minimum hydraulic pressure for municipal services and hospital cooling.

RA-03.action: Reduce traffic cycle times and maintain emergency corridor green wave
RA-03.rationale: Preserves vehicle flow along critical response routes while signal controller runs on degraded power.

RA-04.action: Validate backup generator startup sequence and transfer switch
RA-04.rationale: Guarantees secondary power continuity to critical healthcare loads.

RA-05.action: Bypass lockout and restore full load without breaker audit
RA-05.rationale: Unsafe acceleration attempt to energize feeder without verifying interlocks.

RA-06.action: Quarantine payload and audit telemetry ingress gateway
RA-06.rationale: Quarantines unrecognized asset data to protect digital twin graph integrity.

RA-07.action: Dispatch mobile emergency power unit to hospital H-01
RA-07.rationale: Contingency dispatch because primary backup generator G-01 is unavailable.

substation-failure.name: Substation S-01 failure
substation-failure.description: Primary high-voltage electrical feeder failure cascades downstream into water and traffic services.

backup-generator.name: Backup generator G-01 unavailable
backup-generator.description: Emergency generator G-01 is unavailable, leaving hospital H-01 at high single-point failure risk.

unknown-asset.name: Unknown asset report
unknown-asset.description: Telemetric message references unregistered asset UNKNOWN-999; quarantined by ingress gateway.
